members.title: Multiple Active Ofcom General Condition Breaches Absent from IC Memos
Multiple Ofcom General Conditions Technical Breaches — Low Enforcement Risk
PRS Network Operator Registration Breach — Ofcom Compliance

reasons: All describe the same cluster of Ofcom General Condition technical breaches (mid-contract price rise notifications, end-of-contract notifications, annual best-tariff notifications, VoIP emergency services disclosure, PRS registration) that are documented in the Legal DD but absent from IC memos — noting f076/f080/f116/f126/f215/f255/f286/f299/f328/f352/f423 are grouped separately as they specifically concern the cease charges/GC C2 breach.

members.title: Seller Proceeds Sensitivity and Thin Equity Position Not Disclosed in IC Memo
Seller Equity Sensitivity and Process Dynamics Not Carried Forward to Later IC Memos

reasons: Both describe the same issue: sellers have thin equity due to Ares debt and are extremely sensitive to value movements affecting their ~£88m proceeds, with the 2nd IC Memo disclosing this dynamic and later memos not carrying it forward.

members.title: NHS Deferred Income Unwind as Working Capital Driver Not Surfaced
NHS Digital Strategy Initiative Impact on Working Capital Not Addressed in IC Memos

reasons: Both describe the same issue: the VDD identifies that working capital turns positive in outer years primarily due to the unwind of NHS Digital Strategy Initiative deferred income, a non-recurring driver not disclosed in the IC memos.

members.title: CCaaS Margin Capture Conditioned on Scale Delivery Capability
CCaaS Scale Delivery Risk: Value Leakage to Vendors/SIs Flagged by CDD

reasons: Both describe the same issue: the Altman Solon CDD states that CCaaS margin capture is contingent on Gamma's ability to package and deliver at scale, otherwise value leaks to vendors and system integrators.

members.title: FY31 Gross Profit 4x Growth Thesis: CDD Phase II Validation Absent
Buyside CDD Scoped as Phase I Only — Phase II Completion Status Not Disclosed

reasons: Both describe the same issue: the Altman Solon buyside CDD is explicitly Phase I only, and the IC memo record does not disclose whether Phase II has been completed or waived, leaving independent commercial validation incomplete.

members.title: Multiple Supplier MSAs Contain Outdated Data Protection Provisions
Multiple Supplier MSAs Contain Outdated Data Protection Provisions (DPA 1998)

reasons: Both describe the same issue: multiple supplier MSAs (including Virtual1, Neos Networks, and Virgin Media) contain data protection provisions referencing the superseded Data Protection Act 1998 rather than current legislation.

members.title: £406.5m Debt Repayment Triggered by Change of Control at Close
Change of Control Triggers Mandatory Full Prepayment of All Facilities

reasons: Both describe the same issue: the transaction triggers mandatory full prepayment of all outstanding facilities (totalling ~£406.5m) under change-of-control provisions in both the Senior Facilities Agreement and PIK Facilities Agreement.

members.title: Forecast Constructed on No-M&A Basis Despite Active Acquisition Track Record
FY26–28 Plan Excludes M&A; Thesis Depends on Continued Acquisitions

reasons: Both describe the same issue: the VDD plan projections are built on a no-M&A basis despite the Group's active acquisition track record and M&A-dependent investment thesis, creating a structural gap in the base-case financials.

members.title: ROPA, DP Policy Integration, and Acquired-Entity Privacy Policies Materially Incomplete
Privacy Policy Harmonisation Incomplete Across 9 Group Entities

reasons: Both describe the same issue: the Group's privacy policy and ROPA harmonisation across acquired entities is materially incomplete, with multiple entities still on legacy or non-compliant policies as of the Legal DD date.

members.title: Surgery Connect Ancillary Products: 58% CAGR Assumption Lacks Independent Validation
Surgery Connect Ancillary Revenue CAGR Lacks Independent Validation

reasons: Both describe the same issue: Surgery Connect Ancillary Products are projected at an extremely high CAGR (58–84%) from a nascent base with no independent CDD or FDD validation of this trajectory.

members.title: Cohort 1 Revenue CAGR mathematically inconsistent with stated start/end values
Cohort 2 Revenue and GP CAGRs mathematically inconsistent with stated start/end values

reasons: Both describe the same issue: CAGR figures stated in the 2nd IC Memo for customer cohorts are arithmetically inconsistent with the stated start and end revenue/GP values.

members.title: Supplier Change-of-Control Termination Rights Not Formally Waived
Gamma Telecom Single-Supplier Concentration (£11.9m Annual Spend) Not Highlighted in IC Memos

reasons: Both describe supplier change-of-control consent/termination rights in key supplier agreements that have not been formally waived, creating a pre-completion execution risk not addressed in IC memos.

members.title: Preference Share Coupon Rate Discrepancy Across Share Classes
Preference Share Coupon Rate Inconsistency Across DD Documents

reasons: Both describe the same issue: inconsistent preference share coupon rates across DD documents (A Preference at 14%, B/C Preference at 12%, PIK at 12%), creating a discrepancy that affects the net debt bridge and equity waterfall.

members.title: Legal DD Structural Limitations Not Disclosed in IC Memos
Legal DD Six-Month Staleness Not Acknowledged in Latest IC Memo

reasons: Both describe the same issue: the Legal DD was prepared as a vendor report with a November 2025 cut-off, and by the time of the latest IC memo (June 2026) it is approximately seven months stale, with no acknowledged refresh or bring-down in the IC record.

members.title: South Africa Block D Leases: Landlord Consent Required for Change of Control
South African Leases: Governing Law Outside Legal DD Scope

reasons: Both describe the same issue: South African leases require landlord consent for a change of control, the Legal DD explicitly excludes non-English law analysis, and no IC memo discloses this pre-completion condition or its resolution status.

members.title: SCG Acquisition Count in Chunk 25 (17 since Apr-22) vs. Chunk 27 Average EV/EBITDA (5.0x across 17 transactions) — Cohort GP Declining Despite Low Entry Multiple Claim

members.title: NRR Trough at 94.4% FY24 Not Disclosed in IC Memos

members.title: Own-IP UCaaS Platform (Evonex) Sustainability Not Resolved in Latest IC Memo
